title: Planner: private tasks stored in your private plan instead of Microsoft To Do
summary: The automatic rollout, December target, storage change and Teams controls are supported. The updated licensing documentation warrants two small clarifications: Planner requires a qualifying subscription, and the notice's reference to task history should be distinguished from its published premium entitlement.

claims.quote: Beginning in December 2026, private tasks created in Planner and Planner-powered experiences will be stored in a user's own private Planner plan instead of the Microsoft To Do task store.
